conclusion: Every finite covering system with distinct squarefree moduli has a modulus at most 7.
squarefree_reduction: 8 is not squarefree, so a modulus at most 8 is at most 7.
difference_explanation: The primary verifier adds conservative truncation remainders at the first four stages; the independent verifier evaluates these exactly. Their total difference, entirely accounted for by these four stages, is less than 2e-21.
scope: Disproves a barrier at 10 for this distribution-based comparison; does not settle whether every such covering contains modulus 2.
